pois.label: 罐体（尘暴水银行）
pois.detail: 13 m³ 卧式保温储罐，与取水站服务罐 A 同规格并列。常态保持满罐待命：尘暴季前由 Rodwell 井自动蓄满，全球尘暴期间光伏出力跌至 15% 时，双罐 26 m³ 库存覆盖 60 sol 乘组用水并留 14% 裕度。独立伴热回路防冻。
pois.detail_en: A 13 m3 horizontal insulated tank, identical to service tank A at the well. It normally stands full and waiting: topped up by the Rodwell ahead of storm season, then drawn on when a global storm cuts photovoltaic output to 15% - the pair's 26 m3 covering 60 sol of crew water with 14% to spare. Its heat trace runs on an independent circuit.
pois.sim: TS-01 R1 压力测试：单罐方案在 60 sol 全球尘暴下断供 28 sol（排除）；双罐方案 700 sol 零断供，Stefan 校核结论不变
pois.sim_en: TS-01 R1 stress test: the single-tank option ran dry for 28 sol during a 60-sol global storm and was struck out; the twin-tank option went 700 sol with zero outages, and the Stefan re-run did not change that.

pois.label: 倒罐隔离阀
pois.detail: DN25 双向倒罐线接站内罐 A，双向隔离阀。运行策略先进先出：定期与罐 A 轮换服务角色，防止库存长期滞水。
pois.detail_en: A DN25 transfer line ties this tank to tank A at the well through a bidirectional isolation valve. Operating policy is first-in-first-out: the two tanks swap service roles periodically so stored water never sits still for long.

pois.label: 顶部人孔与液位仪
pois.detail: 顶部检修人孔（橙色盲板）与液位/温度仪表，状态灯夜间常亮指示库存水位。
pois.detail_en: Top service manway - the orange blind flange - with level and temperature instruments. The status light stays lit through the night to show how much water is left in the bank.
